children.value: Navigate the menu by pressing ctrl + arrow for navigation and space to press button.
This game started development at March 7th
Enable debug mode by clicking the fps counter
Run a test by double right clicking the back button on the about page with debug mode
load built in levels in the level editor by typing 'Builtin:' and a number like 1
Exit a game any time by pressing ESC on non touchscreen devices
